name: MetaDrive-0.4.3
body:
Some daily updates.

## What's Changed
* Releases/0.4.2.3 by @pengzhenghao in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/622
* Make the apperance and physics body consistent for lane lines by @QuanyiLi in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/623
* Fix test by @QuanyiLi in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/624
* Update README.md by @zhoubolei in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/625
* Fix minor issues in MARL envs by @pengzhenghao in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/627
* Fix minor issue in gym_wrapper by @pengzhenghao in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/628
* Unpin numpy and gymnasium by @fredyshox in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/630
* Update doc: how to development a new environment by @QuanyiLi in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/631
* Remove docstring coverage bot comment by @pengzhenghao in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/637
* Fix work groups of depth compute shader by @fredyshox in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/633
* Introduce route completion for PG map by @pengzhenghao in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/638
* Deprecate the resource expensive read_summary pipeline by @pengzhenghao in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/639
* Fix the BEV image: the black background and wrong heading when `target_agent_heading_up=True` by @pengzhenghao in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/646
* Fix scenarionet sim by @QuanyiLi in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/647
* trigger ScenarioNet test when update MetaDrive by @QuanyiLi in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/648
* Fix memeory leak by @pengzhenghao in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/640
* Issues in headless / offscreen rendering; add example by @pengzhenghao in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/644
* Fix example by @QuanyiLi in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/657
* Memory leak when rendering (camera / UI) in PG map with multiple scenarios by @pengzhenghao in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/656
* Set default sensor (camera) offset to avoid the camera being inside the objects by @pengzhenghao in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/658
* Fix light by @QuanyiLi in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/661
* Fix test by @QuanyiLi in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/662
* PGMap: customizable starting point by @fredyshox in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/667
* Add prefix to object before spawning to avoid object registered twice in engine by @pengzhenghao in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/659
* Add more examples for semantic observation/sensor in docs by @pengzhenghao in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/669
* fix lane line bug by @QuanyiLi in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/681
* fix expert bug, cover side_detector and lane_line_detector setting by @CarlDegio in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/663
* Fix pedestrian animation in semantics map by @pengzhenghao in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/685
* Introducing the navigation information in info dict by @pengzhenghao in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/690
* Fix default value setting of hpr by @Morphlng in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/682
* Fix CI by @QuanyiLi in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/727
* Opendrive map support from SUMO by @QuanyiLi in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/744
* Fix CI & Fix doc & add example for add traffic to sumo map  by @QuanyiLi in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/746
* Add done state: `on_broken_line_done` by @bongbui321 in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/710
* Introducing a single agent, multi-goal, four-ways intersection environment by @pengzhenghao in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/699
* move pandas to test dependencies + remove geopandas by @maxime-desroches in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/751
* Merge and splits for ramp by @fredyshox in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/734
* show splash screen only when `show_logo` is true by @maxime-desroches in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/752
* remove duplicate `tqdm` dependency by @maxime-desroches in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/756
* Fix ramp rendering by @QuanyiLi in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/759
* fix sidewalk rendering by @QuanyiLi in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/762
* Adjust the scaling automatically in TopDownRenderer by @pengzhenghao in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/776
* SimGen-related code by @pengzhenghao in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/777
* Hotfix the bugs introduced by bounding box env by @pengzhenghao in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/778
* Introduce the ScenarioOnlineEnv by @pengzhenghao in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/779

## New Contributors
* @fredyshox made their first contribution in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/630
* @Morphlng made their first contribution in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/682
* @bongbui321 made their first contribution in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/710
* @maxime-desroches made their first contribution in https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/pull/751

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive/compare/MetaDrive-0.4.2.3...MetaDrive-0.4.3
